title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 26, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.4 (Peaked October 26, 2026 at 17:36 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 370 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Satellites have some energetic company right now! 🛰💡🌎

A prominent dark coronal region and several bright limb structures stand out today, while the coronagraph shows no clear CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
